label: champ_0120_dragon_02
text: I was watching your battle with the Gym Leader\nfrom the sidelines, and I must say...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0120_dragon_03
text: I thought it was simply excellent! Full marks!\nGold star! Extra credit, even![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0120_dragon_05
text: That unrelenting offensive! That flurry of attacks!\nWhat an efficient way to corner the opponent![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0120_dragon_06
text: And what [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0003)]an artfully trained Pokémon! Such a\nvibrant palette of moves![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0120_dragon_07
text: Ah! I do beg your pardon. I didn’t mean to let\nmy emotions run amok like that.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0120_dragon_08
text: Ahem! In summary, I simply wanted to say that\nyou seem to have gotten even stronger.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0120_dragon_09
text: I must admit I’m eager for you to gather all\nthe Gym Badges.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0120_dragon_10
text: As a member of the Elite Four, I await the day\nyou come to face me with great anticipation![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0120_dragon_11
text: Oh, but one thing—don’t let your studies fall by\nthe wayside. Be sure to come to the academy\r\nnow and then![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
